message:
You know those moments when you realize you’ve finally turned the corner from chaos to calm? Recently, we had a little family emergency — nothing major, but enough to make us scramble. I pulled out our go-bags, which I’d finally packed after weeks of procrastination. It felt so good to be the prepared one for once, instead of rushing around at the last minute.  

It reminded us how important it is to have everything ready: a stash of water, important documents, and a simple family plan. Being prepared doesn’t have to be overwhelming; it’s just about having a few essentials in place. What’s your go-to tip for staying ready? We’d love to hear your tricks!
